test_title: PYST 27: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct superlative degree of comparison for the given sentence.

This is one of the beautiful places in the area.

options.text: This is one of the beautiful places in the area.
This is one of the most beautiful places in the area.
This is a beautiful place in the area.
This is one of the more beautiful places in the area.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Option 2) "This is one of the most beautiful places in the area" is the correct choice. 
 
• It uses the **superlative form "most beautiful,**" which signifies the highest level of beauty among all the places in the area.
 
• The phrase **"one of the"** acknowledges that there are other beautiful places, but it **emphasizes **that the given place is among the very best.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is- *'This is one of the** most beautiful** places in the area'.*
